mentions.name: Head Ball Coach
mentions.description: A web-based multiplayer game in which the player acts as the Head Coach of a college football team. Built as a side project since around 2010-2011, originally used to learn databases and cloud technologies, and the author's first attempt at game design.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been working on a web-based multiplayer game that allows the player to act as a Head Coach of a college football team.

https://head.ball.coach/
